# Linklock

> Free subscribe-to-download links for creators. Gate files behind YouTube subscribe, TikTok follow, Instagram follow, and Discord join steps.

Linklock (https://linklock.org) helps creators grow while giving away preset packs, beat kits, mods, and tutorial files. Unlimited free unlock links. Fans do not need an account.
